caseName: Southern California Edison Co. v. Herminghaus
caseNameFull: Southern California Edison Company v. Amelia Herminghaus
attorneys: Mr. Edward F. Treadwell, with whom Messrs. George E. Trowbridge, Wm. M. Conley and John W. Davis were on the brief, for petitioner. Messrs. James F. Peck, Robert Duncan and Annette A. Adams were on the brief for respondents.-

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of a Federal question on the authority of Tracy v. Ginzberg, 205 U. S. 170, 178; Bonner v. Forman, 213 U. S. 86, 91; Central Land Co. v. Laidley, 159 U. S. 103, 112.
